title: LLM free literary concepts (Workbench v1)
description: Structured output for prompt zh-literary-rich-v1. Taxonomy must NOT be visible to the LLM at this stage.

themes.description: Soft target usually 3–5 useful theme concepts; fewer or more allowed when justified. No filler.

devices.description: Soft target usually 0–3 useful rhetorical/device concepts; empty array is valid.

annotation_interpretation.description: null when no personal annotation was provided in the prompt.

notes.description: Optional short research note from the model; not shown as a user-facing tag.

label.description: Short Chinese literary concept label (not a canonical tag id).

brief_rationale.description: One-sentence Chinese rationale grounded in the Quote and/or annotation evidence.
